properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is the live signature scheme of this Solana/Anchor repo: every test signs transactions with Ed25519 keypairs (Keypair.generate() / sendAndConfirm), and the validator-side crates (ed25519, ed25519-dalek) + JS-side @noble/curves back that. Shor-vulnerable; migration is an ecosystem-level deadline (ML-DSA), not changeable in this code alone.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: curve25519-dalek@4.1.3 is the Curve25519 arithmetic backend of ed25519-dalek — the crate that implements every Solana transaction signature in the Rust toolchain this project builds with. Same lockfile entry as LIB-f69df116 (library facet of the same asset).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256/secp256r1 available in the shipped @noble/curves library (pulled by @solana/web3.js); no first-party call site uses it — Solana itself runs Ed25519 only. Presence is the inventory question here; use is not.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 dep on both sides of the toolchain: sha2 crate (Rust) and @noble/hashes (JS) — the latter actively used at runtime for account/instruction discriminators and PDA derivation (web3-raw-test.ts:9). Quantum-safe hash, kept as inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hmac@0.8.1 is a transitive dep of the solana-client/anchor Rust stack in this project's lockfile. No first-party HMAC call site found in the lesson code; shipped in the built test toolchain regardless.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@0.11.0 declared in the test-examples Rust lockfile (transitive dep of the anchor/solana stack). Same lockfile entry as LIB-ea49d4c1 (library facet).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: openssl@0.10.75 is a crypto PROVIDER dep of the solana-client stack (native-tls/HTTP transport for RPC connections). Its version decides TLS capabilities of the client; classical crypto only, no PQ.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: rustls@0.21.12 provides TLS 1.3 for the solana RPC client (gRPC/HTTPS). rustls 0.21 offers only classical key exchange (ECDHE x25519/P-256 etc.); no hybrid/PQ groups. Traffic between tests and validator is harvest-now-decrypt-later exposed. Same lockfile entry as LIB-da9e9820 (library facet).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ring@0.17.14 is the crypto provider behind rustls in this lockfile: AES-GCM, ECDHE (x25519/P-256), ECDSA/RSA verification. Classical primitives; version pins what TLS can negotiate.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: blake3@1.8.2 declared in the hello_world Rust lockfile (part of the anchor-lang/solana stack). Quantum-safe hash; no first-party call site in lesson code.
